about_the_game:
A first-person co-op horror for 1–4 players set in a plague-stricken medieval kingdom. Play as royal mercenaries, explore a map randomly assembled from modules at the start of each session, and face a mysterious cult to cure the infected land and blight. Brew potions, unlock ancient knowledge and choose your path to uncover the ancient wisdom and choose your own path to purify these lands. Communicate with your allies — survival is never guaranteed.

 ▫️ Open-world sandbox — We give you goals and tools, the rest is up to you;

 ▫️ Magic potions everywhere - Every ingredient and potion unleashes unique effects that you can weaponize against enemies, enhance allies, or mess with NPCs;

 ▫️ Three player classes: Doctor, Priestess, and Warrior. Each has special gear and two unique abilities;

 ▫️ Embrace the randomness — Every player ability, game mechanic, ingredient, and potion dances to the rhythm of pure chance and probability;

 ▫️ Track down ingredients, grab treasure, hoard weapons or flip it all to the merchant for fast cash;

 ▫️ Hand-built modular maps mean you'll never step into the same world twice;

 ▫️ Creatures track you by sight, sound, and scent while following their own twisted logic. Time to get sneaky;

 ▫️ Voice chat changes your voice based on what ingredients and potions you use, turning strategy sessions into comedy gold;

 ▫️ Rich storytelling meets beautiful madness, seasoned with pitch-black humor and endless laughs.

Talk, take risks, support — or betray one another. The game features proximity voice chat influenced by the distance between characters and even the ingredients you use/Dynamic voice chat that changes based on player distance and alchemical ingredients. Communication is key to survival, but sometimes silence is truly golden. Work together to overcome the horrors — or watch your friends tilt into madness/Unite against all dangers, or witness your friends' descent into madness/tilt.

A Sandbox Full of Surprises

This isn’t just an adventure — it’s a sandbox of unpredictable experiments. Each expedition is unique: locations rearrange into a new map every time, and unexpected events await/Every journey is one-of-a-kind: locations dynamically combine to create unique maps filled with random events. Alchemy ingredients — a core system/the heart of gameplay — are different every session and may grant… bizarre effects. Will you find healing dust, a dancing fruit, or uncontrollable vomiting this time? There’s only one way to find out.

Mix. Combine. Take risks. Create wild alchemy that changes the game rules as you play.

content_descriptors.notes: The game has a realistic atmosphere. Player characters can die through various means.
